_comment: RA-6921 (P0) platform-key-fallback register. `pendingMigration` is a ratchet baseline — remove an entry in the same PR that migrates it to resolveWorkspaceAiKey(); never add new entries. `platformInternalExceptions` are routes gated by verifyAdminFromDb (staff-only) or a signature-verified webhook (no end-user session at all) — they are never invoked as part of a client's $99/month workload, so they are intentionally left on the platform key permanently. Re-classify an entry here only if its auth gate changes. RA-6932 broadened the detector to also catch routes that delegate key resolution to lib/ai-provider.ts's getAnthropicApiKey helper (which itself falls back to the platform ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). The RA-6932 report-generation family was migrated to resolveWorkspaceAiKey in that PR; the entries below are the remaining non-report routes newly surfaced by the broadened detector — they still delegate to the platform-fallback helper and are owed the same migration. RA-6963 (#1676) migrated analytics/narrative, inspections/[id]/classify, interviews/[id]/suggest-next, interviews/[id]/validate and live-teacher/turn to resolveWorkspaceAiKey — removed from pendingMigration in RA-6971. RA-6971 threaded the workspace key into generateScopeStream for inspections/[id]/generate-scope. RA-6960 migrated the final entry — inspections/[id]/group-readings — to resolveWorkspaceAiKey (route resolves the workspace key and threads it through groupReadings as the gateway override); pendingMigration is now empty. RA-8001 (1d-i): resolveWorkspaceAiKey is not proof of BYOK. It returns the platform key to a funded trial (D-022), so it no longer counts as BYOK evidence, and a route that calls it without BYOK-only evidence (callAI under keyPolicy byok-only, or a check of the resolved key's source against byok) is a platform surface. `platformAllowedSurfaces` names every such surface with its reason; it is a ratchet like pendingMigration: never add an entry without a reason, and remove one when its route goes BYOK-only. The agent path (agents/workflows create and execute) is NOT exempt by this register and is not detectable here: callAI refuses any non-BYOK key at runtime and the routes preflight the key. platformAllowedSurfaces is a register the detector does not yet fully enforce: a surface that reaches the resolver only through a lib helper (field-assist via callAI) is invisible to it.

RA-6998: reasons on a pinned :free OpenRouter model (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, zero platform cost — the :free pin is enforced in lib/ai/openrouter.ts); this route is flagged only for its GEMINI_API_KEY deep_research tool, not the OpenRouter key.
